summary: Ayyadurai's campaign site frames the Gaza war as genocide and calls for Americans to 'break from Zionism.' His platform names ending all US funding to Israel as his first priority, and he has called for cutting all aid, redirecting military assistance to Palestine, and holding Israeli leaders as war criminals. A 2026 25th Amendment petition on his site accuses the Trump administration of binding the United States to genocide and subordinating its interests to Israel and AIPAC.
